svg.text: 20 V / 5 A contract - use a 5 A e-marked cable
Straps: MIN = MAX = 20 V; COARSE = 5 A; FINE = 0 A
PD FAULT disables the load converter
TI EVM compensation / verify after routing
USB PROGRAM: data, CC detection and host 5 V
Logic supplies: PD 20 V / host 5 V → isolated 5 V → 3.3 V
TPS2116: MODE = 0, PR1 = 0 → higher-voltage 5 V source, reverse blocking
Digital I/O: interlocks, sensors and I2C
IOVDD 3.3 V: local bypass at each package supply pin
GP2 HIGH releases Q_MCU_KILL. LOW, reset or unpowered keeps DRIVER_ENABLE LOW.
ADC readings use the 3V3 reference and are approximate. Converter CC/CV regulation is independent.
Status LEDs and debug test pads
BOOTSEL: short to GND during MCU_RUN reset, then release when RPI-RP2 appears.
All testpoints are fitted 1.5 mm copper pads; doNotPlace excludes them from the purchased BOM.
Qualified 20 V PD → fixed 12 V fan supply
Fan stays powered when TEC is off
Pin 3: tach unmonitored / pin 4: PWM open → full speed
